name: Run Club Socials
summary: Weekend morning running clubs doubling as social hubs and community coffee meetups.
evidence: +320% breakout query 'run club near me singles'
YouTube vlog uploads with #RunClub up 4.1x in 30 days
Average watch duration 82% higher than standard fitness vlogs
top_queries: best running shoes for club runs
audience_vibe: High trust, social connection, urban young professionals seeking healthy weekend connection.

name: Gym Girl Lunch
summary: High-protein, no-cook bento box meals tailored for desk workers hitting mid-day workouts.
evidence: +240% Google Search interest for 'high protein easy desk lunch'
Shorts/Reels format averaging 1.8M views across 100K-tier creators
Comment sentiment: 42% asking for macro breakdown or specific grocery brand links
audience_vibe: Action-oriented, eager to purchase specific protein powders, cottage cheese brands, and glass containers.

name: Sunday Reset Routine
summary: Aesthetic ritual combining meal planning, deep cleaning, hydration prep, and digital detox before Monday.
evidence: Consistent 85-95 peak interest every Sunday morning on YouTube
Brand recall in comments is 2.3x higher than standard weekday lifestyle vlogs
Repeat viewer watch-time remains over 65% through sponsored segments
audience_vibe: Calm, aspirational, high propensity to buy home wellness, supplements, and planners.

name: Cold Plunge & Contrast Therapy
summary: Home ice baths, portable chillers, and sauna contrast recovery rituals taking over amateur athletics.
evidence: +140% search surge for 'portable ice tub reviews' and electrolyte replenishment
Creators with under 300K subs achieving 12% higher click-through on affiliate codes
Skeptical comments transitioning into validation and protocol questions
audience_vibe: Performance-focused, research-driven, willing to spend premium dollars on gear that works.

name: High-Protein Snack Prep
summary: 5-ingredient freeze-ahead treats (protein fudge, greek yogurt bark, puffed rice bites) replacing processed bars.
evidence: +210% search volume on YouTube for 'protein snacks without protein powder taste'
High bookmark and save rate across creator uploads (avg 18% save rate)
High purchase conversion for clean nut butters, sugar alternatives, and collagen powders
audience_vibe: Practical foodies, wellness shoppers who buy recommended pantry staples immediately.
